lines.text: Some Pharisees and Herodians are sent to catch Jesus in His words, and they ask about paying taxes to Caesar.
Jesus asks whose image is on a denarius, and they answer that it is Herod's.
The Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, ask whose wife a woman will be after seven brothers married her.
Jesus points the Sadducees to the Red Sea, where God said He is the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
A scribe asks which commandment is most important, and Jesus says to love God and to love your neighbor.
